title: The specified completed augmentation is the normalized derived adjunct
statement:
Let $g:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Fix a Noetherian adic datum $(A,I)$ with $P_n=A/I^n$ and $B_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$ for $T=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Assume the projection-defined coefficient map $c_g:g^{-1}B_X\to B_Y$ is an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let $F(M)=g^{-1}M\otimes_{g^{-1}B_X,c_g}B_Y$ be additive and exact. Use module sheaves, unbounded derived categories, and strict inverse sequences [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-inverse-system]. Let $H=F_D$ and $\widetilde H=F_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}$ be exact termwise descent, identified with the specified left-derived pullbacks by the original universal counits [lem-sf-exact-pullback-counit-normalization]. Write $\Delta_T$ for constant towers, $L_T=R\lim$ for the K-injective total derived limit, and $v_T$ for the unit of the canonical adjunction $\Delta_T\dashv L_T$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit, lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections]. Let $j:\widetilde H\Delta_X\xrightarrow{\sim}\Delta_YH$ be induced by the ordinary constant-tower identity with these normalized comparisons.

For every $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(B_X))$, let $i_K:\Delta_XK\to K_\bullet$ be the strict quotient augmentation and let $\alpha^F_K:HK\to L_Y\widetilde H K_\bullet$ be the actual ambient comparison specified in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], transported by the preceding counit-normalized identifications. Put $a_K=\widetilde H(i_K)j_K^{-1}$. Then, as actual morphisms in the unbounded derived category,
$$\alpha^F_K=L_Y(a_K)v_{Y,HK}.$$
This equality is natural for every derived morphism $K\to K'$.

More precisely, on the flat-term K-flat representative $P$ used in the specified construction, put $P_\bullet=(P\otimes_{B_X}(P_n)_X)_n$ and choose a K-injective tower resolution $r:F(P_\bullet)\to J_\bullet$. After the canonical localization and resolution isomorphisms, both sides of the displayed equality are represented by the chain map $FP\to\lim_nJ_n$ with components $r_nF(P\to P_n)$. The identity is independent of these representatives and resolutions. No completeness of $K$, preservation of products by $F$, or preservation of K-injectives by $F$ is required.

proof.text: Use [lem-sf-exact-pullback-counit-normalization] to identify both specified left-derived pullbacks with exact termwise $F$, including their comparisons on constant towers. In that lemma the tensor pullback written $F$ here is called $G$, and its exact functor is the scalar transport $F'(M)=g^{-1}M$ with scalars along $c_g^{-1}$; its module isomorphism $m:F\xrightarrow{\sim}F'$, $x\otimes b\mapsto b\cdot x$, shows that $F$ is exact and descends termwise to isomorphisms $F_D\cong F'_D$ and $F_D^{\mathrm{Tow}}\cong F'^{\mathrm{Tow}}_D$ compatible with $\Delta$. Since $m$ is natural on complexes, it carries the augmentation and the K-injective factorization below for $F'$ to those for $F$, so the lemma's comparison $\alpha^{F'}_K$ corresponds to the $\alpha^F_K$ of the statement. On the specified flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$, put $C=FP$, $M=F(P_\bullet)$ and $u:\Delta C\to M$, with $u_n=F(P\to P\otimes_{B_X}(P_n)_X)$. The normalized constant-tower comparison identifies $Qu$ with $a_K=\widetilde H(i_K)j_K^{-1}$, not with an arbitrarily chosen isomorphic augmentation. By [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback], the actual exact augmented comparison is $L_Y(Qu)z_{QC}$, where $z$ is its projection-defined constant-tower map. The normalization theorem explicitly extends this ambient construction to every unbounded $K$.

proof.text:
We identify $z$ with $v_Y$. Apply the transpose formula in [lem-weil-pbc-exact-square-derived-counit] with both copies of its abelian categories equal to $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y))$ and $\mathcal B=\operatorname{Mod}(B_Y)$, both left adjoints $\Delta$, both right adjoints $\lim$, and $r,s,\beta$ identities. Identity functors preserve K-injectives and the required square and normalization are identities. Constant towers are exact, and [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] supplies all unbounded tower resolutions and $L_Y$. This is the canonical adjunction induced by ordinary $\Delta\dashv\lim$, as specified in [lem-coef-derived-tower-counit-projections]. Write $\delta_N:Q\lim N\to L_YQN$ for the universal right-derived comparison. For a tower K-injective resolution $q:\Delta C\to I$, the ordinary transpose is the chain map $z^q:C\to\lim I$ whose components are $q_n$. The cited transpose formula and the definition of adjunct give
$$L_Y(Qq)v_{Y,QC}=\delta_I Q(z^q).$$
Since $Qq$ is invertible, this says $v_{Y,QC}=(L_Y(Qq))^{-1}\delta_I Q(z^q)$. The right side is exactly $z_{QC}$ with its resolution identification in [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Hence $z=v_Y$ on every complex representative.

source.place: Tag 0FND (lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general), its chain-level transpose; Tag 09T5 (lemma-derived-adjoint-functors). Applied to the augmented comparison of def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback in returned localization Step 6 / immersion comparison Step 5.

proof.text:
Substitute Step 2 into Step 1 to obtain $\alpha^F_K=L_Y(a_K)v_{Y,HK}$. For the promised representative take any tower K-injective resolution $r:M\to J$ and apply the same transpose formula to $ru:\Delta C\to J$. If $b:C\to\lim J$ is its ordinary transpose, then
$$L_Y(Qr)L_Y(Qu)v_{Y,QC}=\delta_J Q(b).$$
Thus under the canonical resolution isomorphism $L_YQM\cong Q\lim J$ the displayed derived adjunct is $Q(b)$. Ordinary inverse-limit adjunction means precisely $\pi_n b=r_nu_n$ in every cochain degree. These compatible maps commute with differentials because $ru$ is a chain map, and the ordinary limit property determines $b$ uniquely. This proves the asserted chain representative for both sides; no claim that derived projections detect arbitrary morphisms is used. For every choice of $P,r$, the same computation gives the already fixed derived adjunct, so the resulting derived morphism is independent of these choices under the canonical localization and resolution comparisons.

proof.text:
For a derived morphism $f:K\to K'$, let $T(f):K_\bullet\to K'_\bullet$ be the map of the derived quotient-tower functor [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Its augmentation satisfies $T(f)i_K=i_{K'}\Delta_Xf$: on K-flat chain representatives this is $(f\otimes1)(x\otimes1)=f(x)\otimes1$, and the equality descends with the quotient construction. Naturality of $j$ therefore gives $\widetilde H(T(f))a_K=a_{K'}\Delta_Y(Hf)$. Naturality of the adjunction unit and functoriality now give
$$L_Y\widetilde H(T(f))\alpha^F_K=L_Y(a_{K'})L_Y\Delta_Y(Hf)v_{Y,HK}=\alpha^F_{K'}Hf.$$
The computations use exact termwise pullback, tower resolutions, and the ordinary constant/limit adjunction only. They use neither completeness of $K$, preservation of products by $F$, nor preservation of K-injectives by $F$.
